mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM famous_collection WHERE famous_reccount > 0 ORDER BY famous_reccount DESC, famous_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT A.*, B.total_cnt FROM ( SELECT tt1.rnum AS no, tt1.famous_sid, tt1.famous_content, tt1.famous_author, tt1.famous_emotion, tt1.famous_viewcount, tt1.famous_reccount, tt1.famous_time, tt1.reg_id FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, t1.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM famous_collection WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY famous_reccount DESC, famous_time DESC ) t1 WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageSize} * (#{pageNo} - 1) + #{pageSize}) ) tt1 WHERE tt1.rnum >= (#{pageSize} * (#{pageNo} - 1) + 1) ) A CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) total_cnt FROM famous_collection WHERE 1=1 ) B
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO famous_collection ( famous_sid, famous_author, famous_content, famous_emotion, famous_viewcount, famous_reccount, famous_time, famous_update, reg_id ) VALUES ( famous_seq.NEXTVAL, #{famousAuthor}, #{famousContent}, #{famousEmotion}, 0, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{regId} )

INSERT INTO famous_collection ( famous_sid, famous_author, famous_content, famous_emotion, famous_viewcount, famous_reccount, famous_time, famous_update, reg_id ) SELECT famous_seq.NEXTVAL AS famous_sid, '작가' || LEVEL AS famous_author, '명언 내용' || LEVEL AS famous_content, 'P' AS famous_emotion, LEVEL AS famous_viewcount, 0 AS famous_reccount, SYSDATE AS famous_time, SYSDATE AS famous_update, 'user01' AS reg_id FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 1002
mapper.select: SELECT famous_sid, famous_author, famous_content, famous_emotion, famous_viewcount, famous_reccount, famous_time, reg_id FROM famous_collection WHERE famous_sid = #{famousSid}

SELECT A.*, B.* FROM ( SELECT tt1.rnum AS no, tt1.famous_sid AS famousSid, tt1.famous_author AS famousAuthor, tt1.famous_content AS famousContent, tt1.famous_emotion AS famousEmotion, tt1.famous_viewcount AS famousViewcount, tt1.famous_reccount AS famousReccount, tt1.famous_time AS famousTime, tt1.reg_id AS regId FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, t1.* FROM ( SELECT * FROM famous_collection WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY famous_time DESC ) t1 WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageSize} * (#{pageNo} - 1) + #{pageSize}) ) tt1 WHERE tt1.rnum >= (#{pageSize} * (#{pageNo} - 1) + 1) ) A CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) total_cnt FROM famous_collection ) B
SELECT famous_sid, famous_author, famous_content, famous_emotion, famous_viewcount, famous_reccount, famous_time, reg_id FROM famous_collection ORDER BY famous_sid DESC
